title: Break work into deliverable changes
summary: Turn an agreed outcome into reviewable pieces with clear acceptance, owners and dependencies.

sections.label: Plan the pieces
items: Start with the outcome, selected approach and remaining uncertainty.
Choose a small useful result that can be reviewed and checked.
Describe the work, acceptance examples and responsible actor for each piece.
Identify required inputs and dependent work. An existing artifact can satisfy an input.
Separate investigation of an unresolved decision from implementation that depends on it.
Keep integration and end-to-end acceptance visible across the pieces.

sections.label: Example feature slices
rows: Save and reopen a basic search
A supported set of criteria survives reopening.
The user receives the agreed recovery behavior.
A named search behaves according to its acceptance examples.

sections.label: Adapt the granularity
sections.text: A slice may need coordinated UI, service and data changes. Do not claim that every technical subtask is independently releasable. For a bug or debt finding, use the remediation guidance to plan a coherent correction.

sections.label: Breakdown and traceability
sections.text: Breakdown decides which work pieces exist and their order. Traceability explains how those pieces, requirements and checks relate. Use both where they help.

sections.label: Useful result
sections.text: Each work item contributes to the outcome, has checkable acceptance and names its prerequisites. Unknown estimates and decisions remain visible.

confidence: Moderate. Granularity depends on the project

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
